scripts.dev: corepack pnpm run docker:up && corepack pnpm run db:migrate && turbo run dev
scripts.dev:api: corepack pnpm run docker:up && corepack pnpm run db:migrate && turbo run dev --filter api
scripts.docker:test:up: docker compose -p decentdebates-test -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.test.yml up -d --wait
scripts.docker:test:down: docker compose -p decentdebates-test -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.test.yml down
scripts.db:reset: corepack pnpm run docker:down -v && corepack pnpm run docker:up && corepack pnpm run db:migrate
scripts.start:prod:local: corepack pnpm run docker:prod-local:up && corepack pnpm run db:migrate && SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE=false turbo run start:prod
scripts.start:prod:local:api: corepack pnpm run docker:prod-local:up && corepack pnpm run db:migrate && SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE=false turbo run start:prod --filter api --filter notification-worker
